title: CountryFlag
description: A country flag component displaying flag images by ISO country code with optional tooltip and loading states.

size.description: Flag size as a preset or numeric pixel value.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio for the flag image.

alt.description: Alt text for the flag image.

fallback.description: React.ReactNode — Custom fallback content when the flag image fails to load.

tooltip.description: Tooltip shown on hover. Pass a ReactNode or a config object.

basePath.description: Where to load the flag SVG from. Omit to use the flags packaged with the library (no network request). Set it to fetch `${basePath}/${code}.svg` from a CDN or self-hosted directory instead.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for flag sub-elements.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting.

onLoad.description: (event: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => void — Fires when the flag image loads.

onError.description: (event: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => void — Fires when the flag image fails to load.

max.description: How many flags to show before the rest are collapsed into a surplus count.

size.description: Flag size for every member of the group.

showCountTooltip.description: Shows a tooltip on the surplus count listing the hidden countries.

countTooltip.description: Tooltip settings for the surplus count. Its content comes from `surplusTooltipContent`.

surplusTooltipContent.description: Content for the surplus count's tooltip, replacing the generated country list.

renderSurplus.description: Renders the surplus indicator yourself, given the number of hidden flags.

classes.description: Class overrides for this component's slots.
Class overrides for this component's slots.

unstyled.description: Drops the decorative default classes and keeps the structural ones, along with focus, keyboard and ARIA wiring.

size.description: Matches the flag size the placeholder stands in for.

aspectRatio.description: Width-to-height ratio of the placeholder, matching the flag it stands in for.

animate.description: Whether the placeholder pulses. Set false for a still skeleton.

reduceMotion.description: Whether to stop the shimmer animation. `"auto"` follows the OS reduced-motion setting.

count.description: How many placeholder flags to draw.

size.description: Matches the flag size the placeholder stands in for.

animate.description: Whether the placeholders pulse. Set false for a still skeleton.

reduceMotion.description: Whether to stop the shimmer animation. `"auto"` follows the OS reduced-motion setting.

showCount.description: Also draws a placeholder for the surplus count.
